sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that an application Annexure P/4 has already been made by the petitioners to the respondents on 27.12.2023, but no action thereupon has been taken.

02. A perusal of the application dated 27.12.2023 shows that the same has been preferred for declaration of acquired lands as de-notified whereas the contention of the petitioners is that the proceedings have lapsed on account of non-obtaining of possession of lands from them.

03. Thus, in the available facts of the case, it is directed that in case the petitioners make an application before the respondents/competent authority in respect of the grievances as raised by them in this petition, then the said 2 WP-18643-2024 application shall be adverted to and decided by respondents / competent authority within a period of three months from the date of making of the same by passing a reasoned and a speaking order.
04. With the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on merits, petition stands disposed off.

opennyai_summary.facts:
By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioners have raised a grievance to the effect that though their lands were acquired under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 but possession thereof has not been taken as yet due to which the proceedings have lapsed.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that an application Annexure P/4 has already been made by the petitioners to the respondents on 27.12.2023, but no action thereupon has been taken.

04. With the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on merits, petition stands disposed off.
